problem.lead: Not bad luck. Three recurring mistakes — everyone makes them.
problem.t1_text: You buy on hype from a chat. There is nothing to check before entry — you don't know what to check.
problem.t2_text: x10 leverage turns a 10% price drop into minus one hundred percent of your deposit. Most people learn their liquidation price after the fact.
problem.t3_text: Fear sells at the bottom. Greed buys at the top. Without a system, you supply liquidity to those who have one.
problem.closing: The market takes money from the unprepared. Phase 0 here is free — cheaper than your first wipeout.

program.h2: Nine phases: from zero to bot operator.
program.ph0_desc: Blockchain, wallet, candlesticks, order book, probability. 20 lessons from zero.
program.ph1_desc: Python, exchange API via CCXT, the Russian legal framework.
program.ph2_desc: Time series statistics, microstructure, funding arbitrage.
program.ph3_desc: Kelly criterion, VaR/CVaR, dynamic position sizing.
program.ph4_desc: Orders, TWAP/VWAP, on-chain analysis of large players.
program.ph5_desc: Docker, monitoring, Chaos Lab, final exam.
program.attest_note: Assessment after each phase. 80% threshold. Answers are shuffled — cramming is useless.

psychology.h2: The weak link in a trading system is the human behind the screen.
psychology.body: A course with a whole module about you, not the market. 8 lessons on bot operator psychology and 8 trainers. Free together with Phase 0.
psychology.tr1_text: the bot opened a trade overnight. You practice not intervening without a reason.
psychology.tr2_text: you, a month from now, write to yourself today. You read it later.
psychology.tr3_text: a streak of wins is more dangerous than a streak of losses. Test it on yourself.
psychology.tr4_text: how a losing position becomes lifelong — and how to exit.
psychology.shot_caption: Psychology trainer 'Anxiety at 3 AM' — a real app screen.

livemarket.body: Order book, candlesticks, funding rates, fear and greed index — right in the app. Detectors hint at what is happening. These are not signals. This is the skill of reading the market with your own eyes.
livemarket.demo_label: Demo order book · data here is synthetic · in the app — real
livemarket.detector: 💡 Spread doubled. The market is nervous — position sizes usually get cut.
livemarket.detector_calm: Order book is calm. Spread is normal.

news.body: A crypto news feed classified into seven types. The mentor breaks down each item: what happened → where the pressure builds → what the news doesn't say → a question to yourself.
news.exercises: Exercises: 'Guess the type' · 'History knows the answer' · 'Anti-FUD'

aimax.h2: A mentor that gives no ready answers.
aimax.actions: Feynman check with a verdict. 'Explain it differently' — three paraphrases. Socratic mode. Task generator. Three-level hints. Hypothesis critique across five dimensions. A charter auditor looking for loopholes. Error diagnosis across five trap types. Belief sparring: steelman → attack → verify.
aimax.adaptive: The request limit is adaptive: pass a lesson on your own — more requests. Break discipline — fewer.

builders.h2: Build a market artifact with your hands.
builders.list: A token in five steps · a memecoin in three clicks · a stablecoin under an owner run · an NFT: mint one and try to sell it · a DAO vote · oracle verification · a trading bot — the final exam · a year managing a tokenized fund.

kryptik.h2: Every course has a hero. This one has Kryptik.
kryptik.body: A sarcastic senior peer who went through all 134 lessons himself and now runs your training. Breaks down mistakes and names the trap type. Comments on the live market. Asks questions instead of handing out answers.
kryptik.q2: — Makes sense. Wrong, but it makes sense.
kryptik.q3: — That's all for today. We continue tomorrow.
kryptik.closing: He doesn't comfort you with lies and doesn't promise profit. He knows more — and teaches what he knows.

quests.h2: Live through the crisis before it reaches your money.
quests.q1_text: 7 episodes: phishing, a malicious contract, deepfake, SIM swap. The scammer character Skat hunts your virtual assets.
quests.q1_trains: Trains: recognizing social engineering before real money.
quests.q2_text: A week in the life of a bot operator. Each day a new psychological trap whispers a tempting thought. You choose the action.
quests.q2_trains: Trains: resistance to euphoria, night anxiety, and other people's profit screenshots.
quests.q3_text: 6 crisis scenarios: −17% flash crash, liquidation cascade, an exchange freezes withdrawals, regulatory shock.
quests.q3_trains: Trains: telling 'the market is falling' (do nothing) apart from 'the infrastructure broke' (act immediately).
quests.footer_note: In every quest: a virtual portfolio, choices with consequences, a breakdown after each step, a final report with your vulnerability profile. Completion counts toward progress and grants badges.

features.f1_text: Order book, liquidations with a gauge, funding, DeFi yield, equity curves, a correlation map, the MEV sandwich — every lesson is hands-on practice.
features.f2_text: Block race, liquidation corridor, Kelly fan, correlation storm, seed phrase defense, save the deposit.
features.f3_text: Exchange order book, leverage and liquidation, funding rates, walk-forward analysis, overfitting lab, kill-switch.
features.f4_text: From a token in five steps to a trading bot — the course final exam.
features.f5_text: Each term comes with a definition at four depth levels, a real-life analogy, and an English equivalent.
features.f6_text: 80% threshold. A detailed breakdown of every question. Answers are shuffled.
features.f7_text: From fund intern to chief quant architect: ranks, badges, streaks, boss duels.
features.f8_text: Built in. So you don't zone out.
features.f9_text: Questions from different phases mixed together + spaced repetition every 5 lessons.
features.f10_text: A quiet screen with 4-4-6 breathing after a lesson: your brain consolidates what it learned.
features.f11_text: Deterministic RNG — you can't memorize 'the correct answer is always second'.
features.f12_text: Forecast market events and get a score of your accuracy.
features.f13_text: Your recurring traps in one place, classified by type.
features.f14_text: ~2.8 MB, no installation, no server. Download it and use it.
features.widgets_breath: What are the 145 widgets? Order book. Liquidations. Funding. DeFi yield. Equity curves. Correlations. Delta-neutral. MEV. Overfitting lab. Alpha/beta. Kill-switch. Execution. Chaos. Kelly. Cointegration…
features.widgets_more: …and a hundred more — one per lesson.

adaptation.h2: The course adjusts to your mistakes.
adaptation.a1_text: After a wrong answer, the mentor identifies the trap type and logs it with a recommendation on what to reread.
adaptation.a2_text: After a month, patterns show up: 'Thursday evening', 'after reading news', 'when I'm in a hurry'.
adaptation.a3_text: Questions from topics where you err more often come back more often — until it sticks.
adaptation.a4_text: Spaced repetition of what starts to fade. The SuperMemo-2 algorithm.
adaptation.a5_text: On live data and news, your opinion is asked first, then the reference answer is revealed.
adaptation.a6_text: Over time you see where you are actually strong and where it merely 'seems like you know'.
adaptation.a7_text: Independence is rewarded with extra AI requests.
adaptation.a8_text: Live market detectors open only after the matching lessons. A beginner won't drown.
adaptation.a9_text: A before-and-after measurement: real growth in understanding shows up, not a 'read it' checkbox.
adaptation.a10_text: A sarcastic senior peer. Praises rarely, but when deserved.

letter.h2: A letter instead of a marketing department.
letter.body_p1: If you are looking for a 'buy, it will go up' signal, close this page: we don't do that.
letter.body_p2: We build a trainer where you can make as many mistakes as you want — as long as a mistake costs zero rubles. We don't promise profit. We promise a method: 134 lessons, assessments with an 80% threshold, and a breakdown of every mistake you make.
letter.body_p3: The development history is open: from v1 to v7, every commit is visible on GitHub.

faq.a1: No. Phase 0 starts with the question 'what is blockchain' and requires no programming or trading background.
faq.q2: Do you give trading signals or advise where to invest?
faq.a2: No. And we won't. The course teaches a method: statistics, risk management, execution. Decisions stay yours.
faq.a3: All of Phase 0 (20 lessons) and the Psychology module (8 lessons with trainers). No card required. No time limit.
faq.a4: No. One payment covers all future versions: new lessons, widgets, and layers go to everyone who already bought.
faq.a5: Cards from Russia and international cards. Access activates right after payment.
faq.a6: Progress is stored in your browser and syncs to the cloud only under your account. The site has no ad trackers.

final_cta.body: Twenty Phase 0 lessons and the entire psychology module — no card, for good. If it isn't for you, you owe nothing to anyone.

disclaimer.text: CryptoNavigator is an educational simulator. All trades are made with virtual money. Course materials are not financial or investment advice. We do not promise profit. Trading crypto assets can lead to loss of capital.
